protocol.collect: 4096 HAND_GRP episodes, 256 warmup; branch comparison, Zstd, per-file fsync, atomic publication and writer drain included.
protocol.learner: Batch 1024, microbatch 512, 8 warmup updates, distinct 64 updates, weighted 128 updates; checkpoint every 32 updates and GPU completion included.
protocol.initialization: Each architecture freshly initialized from the same Nano checkpoint and config. REGRET output starts at zero. Networks have different structures, so this is not numerical equivalence between old and new models.
protocol.aggregation: Two completed runs for each variant and workload; throughput is total work divided by total elapsed time. No production training run was restarted.

validation.formatter: google-java-format 1.28.0 dry-run passed for all 80 changed/new Java files

corpusConversion.verification: Every Nano board row is byte-identical after decode/encode; decision metadata, policies, actions, utilities, branches and order retained. Conversion is excluded from timing.

baseline-collect.timingScope: Measured collection includes feature encoding, all inference and engine work, GRP, branch completion, and optional compressed episode persistence including writer drain. Completed decisions count retained main-episode choices, including forced choices; branch work is reported separately. Model load, warmup and post-run observation shape decoding are excluded. This is not a Nano-equivalent workload.

baseline-distinct.samplingScope: Diagnostic only: uniform sampling without replacement within each update over all retained rows in the role reservoir, including zero-weight rows. The same row may recur across updates. Stored targets and weights are unchanged; this changes the sampling distribution and is not a training-algorithm setting.
baseline-distinct.timingScope: Headline samples/s includes replay sampling and payload decode, CfrModel.train including observation decode, bucket assignment, CPU preparation, transfer, forward/backward/optimizer, and periodic saveTraining including deferred GPU synchronization. Checkpoints are saved every configured interval and at window end. Internal decode cannot be separated through the public model API; the reported corpusDecodeDiagnosticSeconds is separate setup work, not a subtraction from learner time. Unique processed rows sum within-update distinct identities. Sampling mode is reported separately; uniform-distinct is a compute diagnostic, not production weighted training. Stored teachers and weights are unchanged. Warmup, model/replay load, and corpus preparation are reported separately.
